summary: Implemented the approved tiny static quote board app with saved favorite quotes and updated the Codexa improvement log.
final_summary: Built a dependency-free static quote board with seed quotes, add/delete controls, favorite toggles, favorites filtering, local persistence, responsive styling, accessible labels, and empty states. Fixed a browser robustness issue by using guarded ID generation. Deferred improvement ideas were recorded: categories/tags, import/export, search, mobile browser pass, and a user decision about whether all quotes or only favorites should be considered saved long term.
